evaluator: Fictionalized Margaret Morse analytical lens only. I am not Margaret Morse, do not speak for Margaret Morse, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The homepage supplies a rushed-reader threshold: “The system lives between the screen and the room” connects invitations, meetings, source maps, public action paths, digital surfaces, and handoffs, while the About page explicitly and coherently identifies the lineage as artistic, civic, technical, and social.

Open House is accurately delimited as a ten-day UCSC gallery experiment in communal living and participatory art, with communal decision-making and many-perspective documentation; it visibly joins experimentation, place, embodiment, participation, attention, and shared inhabitation without claiming more than the stated historical example.

196 Artists Residency / Sunday Dinner makes hospitality and care operational: invitation, food, space, welcome, introductions, artist onboarding, independent access, continued support, minimal continuity documentation, and recurring shared-table gatherings are presented as participation infrastructure while participant-level records remain private.

NYC Artist Coalition / FairRentNYC connects civic and technical systems to embodied public participation through campaign websites, public data, source maps, facilitated work at Shoestring Press, and a collective town hall at Market Hotel; its Align–Translate–Implement–Sustain sequence shows how people inhabit the same system across room, list, sources, and follow-up.

WOW List adds a distinct technical-social experiment: Jamie and Richard Caceres co-built natural-language, collaboratively editable event infrastructure around community vocabulary, with organizer onboarding and distribution across 35 city ecosystems; the page credits co-authorship and the wider organizer and participant community.

The target role is immediately legible through the homepage title, dedicated Technical Operations page, capability language, case-study role-fit sections, calls to view the resume, and the served resume’s product and technical project-management profile.

Collective authorship is preserved through repeated co-founder and co-builder wording, named collaborators, organizational courtesy credits, community credits, and explicit statements that policy outcomes and movement accomplishments were collective.

Privacy and dignity boundaries remain visible without burdening captions: Sunday Dinner publishes workflow form but withholds identities, access details, attendance histories, correspondence, and unapproved images; WOW List withholds private user data; coalition materials separate public evidence from protected context. Photographs receive specific place/date/context and photographer or organizational courtesy credits without asserting depicted-person endorsement.

The Knowledge Wiki Graph method reinforces attention, documentation, and care through Known/Open/Protected states, source custody, correction paths, human review, and the explicit distinction between access, evidence, and permission to publish.
safety_findings: No protected praise, private participant record, depicted-person endorsement, sole-credit claim, or production/indexing approval is inferred from the packet.
recommendation: Pass PR-015. The public surface already clears the lens; production release and indexing remain separate decisions.
